sentences.text: Florida’s waterways are full of drawbridges.
To request an opening, sound one prolonged blast followed by one short blast, or call the bridge tender by radio.
Most Florida bridges monitor VHF channel nine.
If the bridge will open, it answers with one prolonged and one short blast.
If it can’t open right away, it sounds five short blasts.
Many bridges open only on a schedule, such as on the hour and half hour, at certain times of day, and the schedules are published in the federal regulations and the Coast Pilot.
Hold well back until the bridge is fully open.
